name: Hidden Past
background: light archival paper with vignette, printed dots and grain; accent #A64B14 only

voice.status: generated speech, never a human recording

rules: Archival photographs are never zoomed, panned, pushed or scaled.
Primary sources and later interpretation are labelled apart on screen.
Dated maps carry their date and say which parts were added later.
Only public-domain scans are given the document treatment.
